name: CommodityPriceReturnTerms
description: Defines parameters in which the commodity price is assessed.

conversionFactor.description: Defines the conversion applied if the quantity unit on contract is different from unit on referenced underlier.

rollFeature.description: Used in conjunction with an exchange-based pricing source. Identifies a way in which the futures contracts referenced will roll between periods.

rounding.description: Defines rounding rules and precision to be used in the rounding of a number.

spread.description: Defines a spread value for one or more defined dates.
